verdict.rationale: Mailchimp clearly publishes a browsable API reference for both the Marketing and Transactional APIs, with per-endpoint descriptions (e.g., add contact, send campaign, API root, send SMS). Nothing in the pack shows the reference is interactive or that its examples can be run. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console or playground, runnable code examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
